      Start over

      Removes every group and every assignment from this browser. Save a project file first if you may want them back.

      Database rows

      Three tables: loot_group, loot_group_item and creature_loot_group. The chance is a percent, and each row is rolled on its own for every kill. The script is plain SQL written for SQLite and MySQL, and replaces whatever those tables held.
